title: Kids Pizza Scrolls
subtitle: with Cheddar and Corn
description: Delicious and easy to make, these pizza scrolls are sure to be a hit – and the kids will love helping you make them too! Pop into school lunchboxes or serve as an after-school snack.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 180C. Line the base of a 20cm x 30cm rectangular baking pan with baking paper. Cut the capsicum into 5mm chunks. Coarsely grate the cheese. Drain and rinse the corn.

Make dough: Combine 300g (2 cups) plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder and 2 tsp sugar in a large bowl. Add 20g butter, then, using your fingers, rub the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse breadcrumbs. Add the yoghurt and 2 tbs milk and stir just until a soft, sticky dough forms.
Roll out dough: Tip the dough onto a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth. Using a rolling pin, roll out the dough into a 30cm x 40cm rectangle.

Add toppings: Spread 2 tbs tomato paste over the dough, then scatter with the Italian seasoning. Top with the capsicum and corn, then scatter over the cheese. Starting from a long side, gently but tightly roll up the dough to form a roll.

Bake scrolls and serve up: Using a large sharp knife or breadknife, cut the roll widthwise into 12 even slices. Put the scrolls, cut side up and side by side, in the prepared pan and bake for 30 mins or until puffed and golden. Turn out and enjoy warm. Store in an airtight container for up to 2 days. Makes 12 scrolls (1 per serve).

Make it again: Make these again using your kids' favourite toppings. Try small chunks of ham and pineapple; cooked chicken and cheese; or use pesto or barbecue sauce on the base instead of tomato paste.
